about_the_game:
Welcome to Burnogue, a minimalist mix of roguelike, auto-battler, and deck-builder where every run forces a choice: lead your team or burn them for devastating power.
Choose from five unique faction leaders, each with their own roster of creatures, items, skills, and playstyles.

KEY FEATURES

  • 120+ Cards to Recruit and Combine, each featuring stunning, frame-breaking pixel art.
  • Fast-Paced, High-Stakes Runs designed for intense and satisfying sessions.
  • Focused Strategic Depth: a minimalist design that removes excess complexity and rewards clever combinations and meaningful decisions.
  • Asynchronous Ranked PvP to test your creations against the world’s best (planned for 1.0 launch).

EXTRA DETAILS

Pay once, play forever. No microtransactions or in-game purchases. All future content and DLCs will be free.
We’re actively developing Burnogue alongside our players. Join our Discord or Reddit to share feedback, report bugs, and help shape the future of the game. We’re listening.
Coming soon. Are you ready to burn?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 150 MB available space

supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese
